title: Description of three Ecopath with Ecosim ecosystem models developed for the Bay of Fundy, Western Scotian Shelf and NAFO Division 4X
documentation_evidence: 203-page technical report with parameters, group derivations and extensive diet appendices for three separate models.
loadability_evidence: Native EwE loadability has not been tested. Public documentation or data availability alone does not establish a fully working reconstruction.
loadability_class: C — parameter and diet tables inspected; model import not tested
quality_rationale: Downloaded DFO PDF203pages title/authors verified. Example Table28 printed88/PDF102 gives B/PB/QB/landings/discards for all three regional models. TableA4.23 printed186/PDF200 and A4.24 printed187/PDF201 give numeric diet composition. Full61-group input documentation and group diets; native load not tested. Full model import and numerical reconstruction remain untested.
extraction_readiness: Parameter and diet tables located; transcription and balance audit required
geometry_method: No defensible digital study boundary located
recommendation: Bay of Fundy, Western Scotian Shelf and combined NAFO Division 4X; not eastern Scotian Shelf.
coverage_note: Bay of Fundy, Western Scotian Shelf and combined NAFO Division 4X; not eastern Scotian Shelf.
